conventions.state_event: One declared reference event plus explicit evolution/transport map to each probe epoch
conventions.tetrad: Orthonormal spatial triad; axis orientation and handedness saved with every tensor

components.name: sigma_STF2
components.unit: H_ref-normalized or inverse-time with explicit convention

components.name: A
components.unit: A/(c H_ref) or declared geometric acceleration

components.name: beta_RM
components.meaning: matter congruence velocity relative to radiation frame

components.name: beta_MO
components.meaning: observer velocity relative to matter frame

parameters.rule: 17 coordinates are a local chart, not a promise of 17 identifiable observables.

frame_composition.contract: Define Lorentz matrices by explicit frame arrows; compose in that arrow order and derive beta_RO from the composed matrix.

likelihood.covariance: C contains statistical noise, shared calibration, foreground, survey window, common LSS and cross-probe terms.
likelihood.rule: Do not add a summary likelihood to the raw likelihood for the same data unless a valid conditional factorization is proved.

cmb.data: Observed PR4/NPIPE frequency maps and supported splits/low-resolution covariance. Component-separated products are alternate estimators of one sky.
harmonic: registered morphology summaries with matched simulation covariance

BI.small_B: deltaT/T=n^T B_* n+O(B_*^2); separate second-order sky monopole by monopole normalization
BI.wolfram_check: For B*=epsilon diag(b1,b2,-b1-b2), O(epsilon^2) sky-mean coefficient = -2 tr(B^2)/15; symbolic residual checked zero.
limits: B_* is integrated anisotropy, not sigma(t0)
no Bianchi V or VII_h inference
noncommuting histories require ordered matrix evolution

cmb.rule: C_ell-only likelihood cannot infer a_lm phase or morphology.

source_count.loglike: sum_i log lambda_r(x_i)-integral lambda_r(x)dOmega dz dF dsize
source_count.rule: Use official random catalogues and selection templates; relative selection values are not absolute per-object probabilities.

astrometry.observable: source-level proper motions with full covariance
astrometry.model: mu_i=VSH_E1(beta/glide)+VSH_B1(frame spin plus physical rotation)+VSH_E2(STF shear)+source motion+systematics
astrometry.rule: B1 equals physical vorticity only after external inertial-frame spin tie and common source-congruence model.

distances.pantheon: Fit observed magnitude/distance modulus with full official covariance, row identity, calibration and selection.
distances.CF4: Use original individual distance measurements; reconstructed peculiar velocities are derived data, not independent observations.
distances.optical: h(n)=Theta/3+sigma_ab n^a n^b-A_a n^a; H_dir(0,n)=c h(n) under declared past-ray/sign convention.
distances.finite_z: H_ratio=cz/D_L and H_diff=c/[d_z(D_L/(1+z))] are distinct estimands.

identifiability.jacobian: J=dmu/dtheta, whiten with full covariance and project shared nuisance directions.
identifiability.target: l^T theta is point-identifiable only if ker(J_eff) subset ker(l^T)

compression.identity: For regular dominated models, score after deterministic T is E[score(D)|T] and I_D-I_T=E[Cov(score(D)|T)] is positive semidefinite.
compression.fixed_cov: At a fiducial point t=J^T C^-1(D-mu0) is locally Fisher-preserving for mean parameters if its span includes J.
compression.parameter_cov: If C depends on theta, include 1/2 r^T C^-1 C_,a C^-1 r - 1/2 tr(C^-1 C_,a) in score.
compression.nuisance_hardening: t_theta_NH=t_theta-F_theta_eta F_eta_eta^-1 t_eta, with local-fiducial and rank limitations.
compression.HTT: T=(x,Q,Pi,F,G_F) is computed from joint posterior samples, retaining shared sample identity and full covariance.
compression.target_loss: For predeclared estimand Psi and deterministic T(D), report E_D[KL(p(Psi|D)||p(Psi|T))]=I(Psi;D|T), with coverage and PPC.
compression.claim: No global sufficiency claim from local Fisher preservation or Gaussian mocks.

fail_closed: No diagnostics if sampler did not execute
No ESS inferred from row count
No stale chain without exact config/source/data identity
No calibrated evidence if matched simulations missing
